- Improved SKILL.md formatting and escaped certain special characters for clarity.
- No endpoint or functionality changes; documentation and configuration instructions only.

Initial release with full feature integration for Bambu Lab printer management via Bambuddy.

- Full integration with a self-hosted Bambuddy instance using REST API and API key authentication.
- Supports printer management, real-time status monitoring, print archives, print queue operations, and archive exports.
- Includes features for filament/spool tracking, AMS, camera snapshots, project management, and notifications.
- Additional support for Spoolman sync, smart plugs, system information, users, groups, and API key management.
- Requires a running Bambuddy server and API key configuration.
